# Requirements

Rex 0.2 is a production standard and the Rex site proved it with a static deployment. Building that site and auditing Rex against Astro (sites) and Next.js (web applications) exposed what a user of either expects and Rex lacks: a declared document head, content collections, islands, declared redirects, host adapters, a typed env, section frames, a Link, prefetch, CDN caching, on-demand regeneration, HTTP endpoints for read actions, a site starter, generators and a developer loop with findings in the browser. 0.3 adopts each as one declared, derived, addressed and checked pattern, never a second pattern for a problem Rex already solves, and never a wheel reinvented where a proven shape exists.

## Requirement 1: The declarations grow, the contract follows

**User Story:** As an agent writing a Rex app, I want every 0.3 capability to be a field on a declaration I already know so that the manifest, the sidecar and rex check tell me about it without a new file convention.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. page() accepts chrome.description, image, frame, order and icon, islands, prefetch, fallback, a rest route segment and paths { action, map }; action() accepts http, cache and optimistic; defineConfig accepts site, redirects, deploy, env, prefetch, security.forwarded, images.remote, fonts[].variable and fallback and i18n.direction; each invalid value throws its REX code with the field name and the tests in core name every code.
2. buildManifest writes every new field, validates action.invalidates names, http path collisions and redirect sources, and AGENTS.md lists redirects, deploy, endpoints, islands and locales; the sidecar payload carries document, loaders, locale, locales, direction, frame and the region island and optimistic fields and validates against sidecar.schema.ts; the text renderer prints the Loaders table.
3. @sidioralabs/rex/errors exports the catalog with hints and areas and resolves in the packed tarball with types; the demo and the site pass rex check unchanged.

## Requirement 2: A declared document head

**User Story:** As a site author, I want every page to carry its title per path, description, canonical and social tags so that Rex sites pass Lighthouse SEO like an Astro site does.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A server-rendered and a prerendered document carry one title through site.titleTemplate with {param} placeholders filled, a meta description, a canonical link from site.origin, og and twitter tags, hreflang alternates under prefix routing and a rel=alternate link to the markdown rendering; the h1, the announcer, the text renderer and the sidecar document field carry the same resolved title and description.
2. The non-script head of the app's index.html reaches dev and production documents with the Rex-owned tags filtered; the form confirmation and error pages use the same head; a static page ships no module script, modulepreload or rex+data script from the dev server, the node build and the edge target, and a missing ActionForm is REX405 at render in dev.
3. After a client navigation document.title, the canonical link and the description equal the sidecar document; check/rules/document.ts reports shared-title, no-description, index-html-owned-tag, image-missing and site-origin with file and line, and parity/runtime compares the rendered title with the sidecar.

## Requirement 3: One way to navigate, on every page, with or without JavaScript

**User Story:** As an agent operating a Rex app, I want every link to be an addressed anchor that works before hydration so that a static page and a hydrated page offer the same controls.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. Link renders a[data-rex-nav] with the typed href from the page declaration or a page id of the generated RexPageId union, navigates through the route change with the target's transition, validates params in dev and navigates by document under REX_STATIC_HOST; parity/nav-target reports a page id string that names no page folder.
2. The back and recovery controls are Links with the target href, so they resolve on a prerendered static page with JavaScript disabled; a push scrolls to the top or the URL hash after the transition and a traverse restores the previous position; nav.to and Link accept scroll false.
3. A throw in view.tsx, states.tsx or a region outside a RegionBoundary renders the page's RecoverableError under main[data-rex-page-error] with REX335 in the outcome store and the reserved region id page in the sidecar regions, with a retry that remounts; a throw in the shell renders the startup error markup with Retry.

## Requirement 4: Prerendered pages on every target with CDN caching

**User Story:** As an operator, I want prerendered pages cached by the CDN and served on the edge target so that a Rex deployment performs like an Astro or Next.js one behind a proxy.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A prerendered page for the anonymous actor answers public, s-maxage and must-revalidate or stale-while-revalidate derived from revalidate, Vary carries Cookie, x-rex-density and the Client Hint names, an actor or ssr render answers private, no-store, index.md follows its page, GET /rex/manifest answers an ETag and 304, hashed assets are immutable on the node adapter and dist/client/_headers carries the same table on the static target.
2. rex build --target edge writes the prerendered pages, index.md and dist/prerender.json, the edge entry serves them through installEdgeStaticPages with the Cache API store and regenerates a stale revalidate page after the response through waitUntil, answering the same x-rex-static status as node.
3. With security.forwarded true a POST to /rex/rpc through a proxy that sets X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Proto passes the Origin check and CORS; without it the check compares the request URL as today.

## Requirement 5: Content as data

**User Story:** As a site author, I want markdown files to be typed entries listed and read like any Rex data so that a Rex site has what Astro collections give and the agent reads the markdown source.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. memoryStore, drizzleStore and contentStore pass the conformance suite for sort, range and in queries; a markdown() field renders to html with heading ids, a headings list and highlighted code through renderMarkdown; Prose renders the html under data-rex-prose through unsafeHtml and Toc renders the headings as links.
2. contentStore lists and gets entries from app/content/<name> validated by the entity, with the key from the file slug and the body in the markdown field; paths { action, map } runs the read action through the router with policy, validation and audit at prerender; content/invalid-entry, content/unbound and parity/paths-handler report with file and line; the content role is importable by no role.
3. rex make collection <name> writes an entity, a content folder, a data module, two read actions and two pages that pass rex check; the text renderer of a page whose loader returns a markdown field appends the markdown source after the sidecar.

## Requirement 6: Deploy anywhere with one switch, preview everywhere

**User Story:** As an operator, I want rex build to write the files my host needs and rex preview to serve the result so that deploying a Rex app is one config field.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. deploy.host selects the build target and the writer: cloudflare writes wrangler.jsonc, vercel .vercel/output with config.json, static/, the function and prerender-config files, netlify netlify.toml and the function, deno-deploy deno.json, docker Dockerfile and .dockerignore, github-pages .nojekyll; each writes the declared redirects natively; the manifest records deploy { host, target } and the start hint names the host's command.
2. dist/ copied alone to a directory without node_modules starts with node server.js and answers /rex/health 200 and the rex: serving line; deploy/host-target reports revalidate on a host without a page store, a params page on github-pages that is not prerendered, and a mutating action on a static host without client.apiOrigin.
3. rex preview serves a node build through the node adapter and a static build through adapters/static-host.ts with index resolution, 404.html, content types, Accept-CH and the _headers table, printing rex preview: serving <url>; the site's Playwright webServer and tools/smoke-package.sh use it.

## Requirement 7: The region is the island

**User Story:** As a site author, I want a static page to hydrate only the region that needs JavaScript so that a Rex site ships as little JavaScript as an Astro site.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A static page with islands ships only the listed regions' chunks and one boot script, each region hydrating at load, idle or visible with data-rex-island and data-rex-hydrated, adopting the page's sidecar script and handling ?act= on boot; the chunk table lists island chunks under the page budget.
2. On an ssr or ssg page a region declared idle or visible keeps its server HTML visible until its chunk arrives and a never region stays server-only with its actions as forms; the manifest lists pages[].islands and the sidecar region entries carry island.
3. render/static-needs-js reports a non-island region of a static page importing act, useAct, useOverlay, useLoader, useStore or a page hook with the hint to declare it in islands or render an ActionForm; render/region-needs-js reports a never region referencing an action with a shortcut; parity/runtime mounts islands and checks their controls against the sidecar.

## Requirement 8: Static sites in every locale

**User Story:** As a reader of a multilingual Rex site, I want every page in my locale at its own address so that a static host serves it with no redirect JavaScript.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. Under prefix routing rex build writes one index.html, index.md and sidecar per locale and path, the root document is a locale chooser with addressed links and a meta refresh, the static cache keys by path and locale, and i18n/static-locale reports several locales with routing none on a prerendered page.
2. The server answers 307 to the resolved locale for an unprefixed document request and sets Content-Language and Vary; the sidecar, manifest and AGENTS.md carry locale, locales and direction; the shell locale switcher renders one control per locale with data-rex-locale as links under prefix routing and as a form under none, the palette lists them and ?locale= switches.
3. Framework chrome strings resolve through rex.* messages with shipped English defaults and the confirmation and error pages carry lang and the localized copy; i18n/missing-key reports an undefined key and i18n/locale-parity a key or ICU argument that differs between locale files; placeholder, alt and aria-description are checked like label.

## Requirement 9: Findings in the browser, the walk in the package

**User Story:** As a developer, I want rex check findings and runtime errors in the devtools while I edit and the operability walk shipped as a library so that every Rex app proves the agent contract the way the demo does.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. rex() called from vitest.config.ts picks up ui.components, fonts, i18n, images, env and secretNames from rex.config.ts and ships no rex:boundary plugin under test; the demo and site vitest configs are plugins: rex().
2. Editing a region to import another page sends a boundaries/cross-page finding to the devtools Check panel with rule, file:line, hint and docs link within one hot update and prints the same line in rex dev; rex check --watch re-reports on change; a REX307 thrown from a region lists in the Errors panel and renders the dev details block; the devtools open by click on data-rex-devtools-toggle, by shortcut and by ?devtools=sidecar.
3. @sidioralabs/rex/testing/playwright exports the walk helpers and gate runners; the demo and site walks import them and the helper test runs walkPage against the fixture app served by rex preview.

## Requirement 10: Images and fonts from the declaration

**User Story:** As a site author, I want images resized and converted at build and fonts served without layout shift so that Rex pages hit the vitals an Astro or Next.js page hits.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. rex build writes the images.sizes by images.formats variants of a local Img source, Img with sizes renders srcset from them and a picture element with one source per extra format, the priority preload carries imagesrcset and imagesizes, a remote src outside images.remote throws REX314 and media/img-sizes and media/remote-image-origin report with file and line.
2. A FontSpec with a local src emits :root { --font-<name> } and a Family Fallback face with size-adjust, ascent-override, descent-override and line-gap-override computed from the file, in SSR, prerendered pages, csr documents and the static shells; tokens/font-family reports a font-family literal that is not the variable or a generic family.

## Requirement 11: The routing contract: every path answers correctly

**User Story:** As an agent, I want an unknown path, a nested content path, an old URL and a missing record to answer the status and page the manifest predicts.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A route ending in :path* matches any depth, params.path is a string array on client, server, prerender and the text renderer, pageHref and nav.href join it, the manifest marks the param rest and the JSON schema says array of strings.
2. An app with app/pages/not-found renders it for an unmatched path with data-rex-page not-found, the sidecar and the outcome region, the server answers 404 with its HTML and markdown, the static target writes it as 404.html with zero JavaScript, the palette and nav exclude it; an app without it keeps the built-in fallback.
3. Invalid route params and a loader NOT_FOUND answer 404 with the TerminalError state, a loader FORBIDDEN answers 403, other failures stay 500, x-rex-render names the kind and the text route answers the same statuses; an unmatched path that a declared redirect covers resolves on the client to the destination with replace.

## Requirement 12: Mutations drive every cache

**User Story:** As an app author, I want a mutating action's invalidates to refresh the client, the server cache and the prerendered pages, and the region to show the optimistic value meanwhile.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. A read action with cache { maxAge } answers from the server cache within maxAge for the same input and actor or locale by scope, every call still writes an audit record with cached true, the policy runs before the cache, and a mutating action whose invalidates names it purges the entry.
2. After a mutating action succeeds every prerendered entry whose page loader it invalidates regenerates in the background and the audit record lists the paths; a static page regenerates through the zero-JS renderer; page.fallback render stores a generated entry on the first miss and not-found answers 404; render/regenerate-unreachable warns where the target cannot regenerate.
3. While a mutation with optimistic is pending the matching loader queries show next(current, input), the region carries data-rex-optimistic and the sidecar region entry optimistic true, both cleared on settle; an error restores the snapshot; parity/runtime asserts the attribute clears.

## Requirement 13: A typed env and a server entry that shuts down cleanly

**User Story:** As an operator, I want secrets validated at start, never bundled, and reachable in handlers on every runtime so that the same action runs on node and on the edge.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. rex:env exports client with the VITE_ values validated and inlined and server with the schema-validated values from process.env or the edge bindings; a client import of server is REX440; the built server exits with REX451 naming a missing or invalid key; handlers read ctx.env and app/server modules import { env } from rex:env; boundaries/process-env reports process.env in an action, flow, data or app/server module.
2. rex dev loads .env, .env.local and .env.<mode> into the in-process server; the generated entry stops on SIGTERM and SIGINT after the static cache settled and the adapter closed within REX_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS and exits at once on a second signal; the node adapter keeps alive 65 seconds behind proxies.

## Requirement 14: Derived endpoints and derived files

**User Story:** As a site author, I want a sitemap, a robots file, an llms.txt, a feed and a JSON endpoint without writing a route so that crawlers and agents read the same inventory the manifest lists.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. An action with http answers GET or POST at its path through the router with policy, validation and audit, as JSON or a string body under contentType, the manifest and AGENTS.md list it, a GET endpoint whose input accepts {} is written to dist/client<path> on every target that prerenders, and security/http-post-open reports an open POST endpoint.
2. With site.origin set the server answers /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt and the static target writes sitemap.xml, robots.txt and llms.txt from the manifest and the prerender list with hreflang alternates and lastmod; a declared redirect answers Location with its status before the render route and the static target writes its meta-refresh stub with a canonical link and a data-rex-nav link; site/scripts/sitemap.mjs and site/public/robots.txt are deleted and tools/site-verify.mjs reads the derived files.

## Requirement 15: The shell is derived, sections included

**User Story:** As an app author, I want section navigation, nav order, icons, breadcrumbs and prefetch from the page declarations so that no Shell override hand-codes a navigation table.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. Pages sharing chrome.frame render inside the named frame export with data-rex-frame, the frame persists across navigations inside the section and receives the section links and the breadcrumb trail from chrome.back, each link a[data-rex-nav]; the default Frame renders both navs; parity/frame-missing reports a frame the ui.components module lacks.
2. The derived navigation and the palette Pages group sort by chrome.order then id and carry chrome.icon; a page's chunk and declared loaders prefetch on pointerenter and focus (hover) or viewport entry per page.prefetch or the config default, never under saveData, 2g or agent density, and a static build prefetches the target document instead.

## Requirement 16: Generators and hygiene from the first command

**User Story:** As a developer starting a Rex app, I want the generated project to carry its tests, ignores, env example and upgrade path so that the first commit is clean and the next version is one command.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. rex make page accepts --route, --render and --load and writes a params route with paths for a prerendered page, rex make page not-found writes the reserved page, rex make action --read and rex make loader write the one loader pattern, rex make test writes the page test; every generated page passes rex check.
2. rex new writes vitest.config.ts with rexVitest(), the test dependencies, a page test per page, .gitignore, README.md and .env.example and runs git init with an initial commit unless --no-git; rex upgrade rewrites the pinned dependencies, installs, runs the codemods for the detected version and ends with rex check; rex add installs DesignX items; tests/page-has-test warns on a page folder without a test.

## Requirement 17: The demo and the site template use every feature

**User Story:** As a reader of the docs, I want the demo and rex new --template site to show every adopted feature working so that nothing in 0.3 is a claim without a running example.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. examples/demo uses every feature of [design] demo_usage, rex check reports zero findings, the unit tests pass, rex build on node, edge and static writes the derived files, and the walk, no-JS, axe, vitals and Lighthouse gates pass through the shipped helpers with the SEO threshold.
2. rex new <name> --template site writes [design] site_template, rex check exits 0, rex build --target static writes every page, 404.html, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt and index.md per page, and the generated operability spec walks it; rex new --example demo installs the example and --host fills deploy.host and the start script.
